Open VitaBridge

Care, connected. On your device.

Choose an Android development preview or install the web app. This app does not contact emergency services or provide background call reception or tracking.

Android 8.0 and newer

The APK becomes available after the GitHub Android build completes successfully. If no release exists yet, check the build status below.

Download Android preview APK · Release notes and SHA-256 checksum · Build status

Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser. Only install the file from the repository above. Development signing is separate from a future Play Store release; reinstalling may be necessary if the development signing key changes.

iPhone and iPad

Open the VitaBridge website in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. A native iOS App Store binary has not been built.

Android browser or desktop

Use your browser’s Install app or Add to Home Screen option when available. The application needs connectivity for sign-in and live website access.
